display.title: United Like One Person: Achdus at Har Sinai
display.summary_short: At Har Sinai the Jewish people camped 'like one person with one heart', and in that merit received the Torah; so too today we must show Hashem we are united.
display.summary_long: A very short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show before Shavuos. Uncle Yossi tells the children that when the Jewish people stood at Har Sinai to receive the Torah they were completely united, as our Sages say, like one person with one heart. The Torah hints at this with the word 'vayichan', 'and he camped', written in the singular where we would expect the plural 'and they camped'. In the merit of that unity they received the Torah from Hashem. So too today, we must show Hashem that we are a united people who love one another and share our good fortune with each other. The clip ends there; in the broadcast it leads into an invitation to help friends join Tzivos Hashem.
display.lesson: Unity among Jews is what made us worthy of the Torah; love one another and share with each other.
